original_summary_bookkeeping.note: Original report and scores remain unchanged; the separate correction receipt binds a two-field derived summary correction.

reused_holdout.scope: Reused finite benchmark cases, not fresh unseen examples.

training_choice.note: Every selected expression passed all training cases or failed all training cases in this finite cohort.

method.candidate_id_note: Candidate IDs are intent-specific; cross-intent counts are descriptive only.
method.choice: Parsed from raw response answers.body_ir_search.choice and cross-checked against event refs, route, compiler result, and independent replay.
method.cli_time: resource.json cli_active_wall_ms is compiler process active wall time; harness_sampling_window_ms additionally includes sample cleanup.
method.post_response_time: Captured proxy event duration_ms per raw choice POST, bound to request/response file hashes; end-to-end loopback exchange duration, not model-forward-only time.
method.ps: Process-level ps snapshots nominally every 120 ms. CPU seconds are coarse deltas of cumulative process CPU time; CPU-percent max and RSS are sampled process values, not instantaneous host CPU increase or exact per-call CPU attribution.

scheduling.note: Measured CLI start/finish intervals do not overlap.

method.scores: Per-call independent Go replay. Holdout vectors are reused benchmark examples, not fresh unseen generalization evidence.

next_experiments.design: Run at least 10 repeats per each of the 24 intent/arm/model cells; balance arm/model order within each intent block and retain per-call timings.
next_experiments.name: Increase balanced repetitions and randomize blocks
next_experiments.why: Three repeats per cell are descriptive and do not estimate request-level variability precisely.

next_experiments.design: Precommit fresh held-back cases per intent before capture and exclude all evaluation values from prompts and feedback; score only after choices finish.
next_experiments.name: Use fresh concealed evaluation cases
next_experiments.why: Current holdout cases are reused benchmarks, and three choices that missed training passed all holdout cases.

next_experiments.design: Compare no feedback with source-bound exact observations, failure-only observations, and verified corrective feedback while holding model, prompt, and cases fixed.
next_experiments.name: Ablate feedback content and trust boundaries
next_experiments.why: External feedback had 27/78 training and 84/96 reused holdout passes, versus 48/78 and 87/96 for compact without feedback.

next_experiments.design: Record monotonic request receipt, inference start/end, response write, and CLI start/exit; collect OS process counters after exit or sample every 20–25 ms.
next_experiments.name: Measure service and CLI timing at higher resolution
next_experiments.why: 120 ms sampling yields one to three snapshots for short CLI runs; multilingual CLI CPU deltas are missing.

next_experiments.design: Repeat warmups in both model orders and measure separate cold-start and warmed steady-state cohorts.
next_experiments.name: Counterbalance cold and warm model order
next_experiments.why: There was one warmup per model; English warmup POST took 537.628 ms versus measured median 238.501 ms.

next_experiments.design: Add multiple precommitted training and evaluation inputs that distinguish each distractor, especially boundaries and neighboring values.
next_experiments.name: Expand discriminating boundary cases
next_experiments.why: Three or four training inputs and four reused holdout cases make outcomes coarse.

operational_outcomes.note: A nonzero candidate Go test exit is a scored selection miss when it equals expected_test_exit_code; it is not an operational replay failure.
